metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; F is a control. Probes are analysis-only, fit on a regime's train, tuned on its val, evaluated once on the untouched test hard tail. Every predeclared stage and capacity is reported; no test-based activation or capacity selection.

primary_decision.rule_note: T-MIX first (subtype spread >= 0.15 at >= 2 KEY stages or E/F categories disagree); T-C if e_t AND h_reset >= 0.50 with cand_input >= 0.10 weaker; T-B if encoder best >= state best + 0.10 and encoder best >= 0.50 with held-out support; T-A if encoder best <= 0.25 and state best >= encoder best + 0.10 with held-out support (>= 4/5 seeds); T-D if both pathways weak/no material difference, nothing reaches 0.50, and held-out <= 0.25 everywhere. Bars are declared conventions; continuous effects reported.
